description: This Java source file defines a final utility class 'CategoryWorker' that provides various static methods for category management in the OFBiz framework. It includes functions for retrieving categories, managing category trails, checking product-category relationships, and handling category content wrappers, all intended to support web and service components of the project.

classes.name: CategoryWorker
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods for category management within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getCatalogTopCategory
methods.description: Retrieves the top category for the catalog, considering request parameters, session, and default properties.

methods.name: getCategoriesWithNoParent
methods.description: Fetches all categories that do not have a parent category.

methods.name: getRelatedCategories
methods.description: Retrieves categories related to a given parent ID, with optional view limits.

methods.name: getRelatedCategoriesRet
methods.description: Returns a list of categories related to a specified parent, with support for recursion and empty category filtering.

methods.name: isCategoryEmpty
methods.description: Determines if a category has no products or subcategories.

methods.name: categoryMemberCount
methods.description: Counts the number of products associated with a category.

methods.name: categoryRollupCount
methods.description: Counts the number of parent categories a category is rolled up into.

methods.name: setTrail
methods.description: Sets the breadcrumb trail for categories in the user session.

methods.name: adjustTrail
methods.description: Adjusts an existing breadcrumb trail based on current and previous categories.

methods.name: getTrail
methods.description: Retrieves the current breadcrumb trail from the session.

methods.name: setTrail
methods.description: Stores the breadcrumb trail into the user session.

methods.name: checkTrailItem
methods.description: Checks if a category is present in the breadcrumb trail.

methods.name: lastTrailItem
methods.description: Retrieves the last category in the breadcrumb trail.

methods.name: isProductInCategory
methods.description: Checks if a product belongs to a specific category, including variant products.

methods.name: filterProductsInCategory
methods.description: Filters a list of product value objects to only those in the specified category.

methods.name: getCategoryContentWrappers
methods.description: Builds a map of category content wrappers for a list of categories, including subcategories.

methods.name: getCategoryTrail
methods.description: Constructs a complete category trail from a specific category ID up to the root.
